item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Trump Says Peace Deal Is Near
item.description: President Trump said the United States and Iran had “largely negotiated” an agreement, but American and Iranian officials described the terms differently.

item.title: Once Trump’s Co-Pilot Against Iran, Netanyahu Is Now a Mere Passenger
item.description: A partner in the war, Israel has been largely left out of the peace talks, a humbling setback for its prime minister with significant risks for the country.

item.title: Middle East war live: Pakistan offers to host next Iran-US peace talks 'very soon'
item.description: Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said his country hopes to host the next round of Iran-US peace talks, positioning Islamabad at the centre of mediation efforts as President Donald Trump said a largely negotiated agreement could soon reopen the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.

item.title: Israel's Ben-Gvir sees 'no innocent people in Gaza or even Europe': Journalist Gideon Levy
item.description: FRANCE 24's François Picard welcomes veteran Israeli journalist and Haaretz columnist Gideon Levy. He offers a scathing analysis of Israeli politics, the Gaza war, the unprecedented rise of xenophobic nationalism and Israel's growing dependence on the United States. Speaking from Tel Aviv amid mounting electoral tensions, Levy argues that "everything – war and peace, domestic politics, legislation – is now covered by the shadow of the upcoming elections".

item.title: Many Questions, Few Details in Latest Iran Peace Proposal
item.description: It is too early to tell what exactly Trump and Iran have agreed to, or if they have agreed to much at all.

item.title: Trump says a deal with Iran and opening of Strait of Hormuz are 'largely negotiated'
item.description: President Trump announced the unfinalized deal on social media after talks with Israel and other allies. It aims to end the war and includes two-month negotiations on Iran's nuclear program.

item.title: Russia pounds Kyiv with missiles and drones, shaking city center and injuring 10
item.description: Russia has launched an intense missile and drone attack on Kyiv, shaking buildings across the city center

item.title: Iran and U.S. Officials Signal Progress as Cease-Fire Hangs in Balance
item.description: As people across the Middle East braced for the possibility of renewed fighting, officials from both sides said there were signs that they were moving closer to an agreement.

item.title: I survived a missile strike in the Strait of Hormuz, but my friend has not been found
item.description: Sunil Puniya was on his first sea job when a missile struck the oil tanker Skylight at the start of the Iran war.

item.title: 'Significant movement here in Washington': US and Iran report progress towards deal on ending war
item.description: FRANCE 24 correspondent Fraser Jackson speaks from Washington, DC on the reported progress in the talks on ending the US-Israeli war on Iran.
